import re

RULE = re.compile(r"^=+(?: =+)*\s*$")


def cut(row, spans):
    """Slice a row at the rule's column edges; a value that overflows its
    column (the tool pads by one char more than the rule) runs on to the
    next space, and the next column starts after it."""
    vals, pos = [], 0
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(spans):
        a = max(a, pos)
        if k == len(spans) - 1:
            b = len(row)
        else:
            while 0 < b < len(row) and row[b - 1] != " " and row[b] != " ":
                b += 1
        vals.append(row[a:b].strip())
        pos = b
    return vals
MSG = re.compile(r"^(?P<level>INFO|ERROR|WARNING):\s*(?P<text>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    blocks, skip, msgs, msg_lines = [], [], [], []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i]
        if RULE.match(ln) and i > 0 and lines[i - 1].strip():
            # the rule under the header gives the fixed column widths
            spans = [(m.start(), m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r"=+", ln)]
            names = [v or "col%d" % (k + 1) for k, v in enumerate(cut(lines[i - 1], spans))]
            used, recs = [i - 1], []
            skip.append(i)
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() and not RULE.match(lines[i]):
                recs.append(dict(zip(names, cut(lines[i], spans))))
                used.append(i)
                i += 1
            blocks.append({"name": "processes", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": recs})
            continue
        m = MSG.match(ln.strip())
        if m:
            msgs.append({"Level": m.group("level"), "Message": m.group("text")})
            msg_lines.append(i)
        i += 1
    if msgs:
        blocks.append({"name": "messages", "kind": "table", "lines": msg_lines, "records": msgs})
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
